name: ksearch-staging
description: Stage and validate K-Search experiment submissions: A-quant caching (GEMM), KSPLIT probe (MoE), metadata fixes (MLA)

agents.name: gemm-specialist
agents.role: GEMM kernel optimization — A-quantization caching, split-K tuning, per-shape kernel selection
key_tasks: Generate and stage A-quant cached submissions
Create split-K variants combining caching with per-shape tuning
Stage aiter reconnaissance probe for GEMM
Analyze benchmark results and update GEMM tree

agents.name: moe-specialist
agents.role: MoE kernel optimization — KSPLIT validation, per-shape tuning, contingency strategies
key_tasks: Stage and analyze KSPLIT validation probe
Prepare contingency strategies if KSPLIT is dead code

agents.name: mla-specialist
agents.role: MLA kernel optimization — adaptive num_kv_splits, qseqlen/TP metadata fixes, FP8 vs MXFP4
key_tasks: Apply template fixes (qseqlen, TP-aware splits, buffer safety) to submission
Test FP8 vs MXFP4 KV format per shape
Validate tree nodes against actual benchmark shapes

coordination.lock_protocol: COORDINATION.md — one popcorn-cli submission at a time
coordination.rate_limit: 1 leaderboard submission per hour per problem

reuse_instructions: To respawn this team: read this file, create tasks per agent, spawn with the same prompts. Each agent works on its kernel independently. Coordinate popcorn-cli submissions sequentially (lock protocol).
